source_identity.rule: Any source or protocol change after freeze invalidates the reserved holdout for that changed candidate.

variables.name: september_arctic_sea_ice_area
variables.operator: September monthly mean area on the published observational definition

variables.name: march_arctic_sea_ice_thickness
variables.observation_source: operational satellite thickness product available under frozen acquisition rules

variables.name: global_mean_surface_temperature_anomaly
variables.observation_source: HadCRUT5 or successor only if continuity metadata document equivalence
variables.operator: annual global anomaly using the protocol baseline

baseline_periods.gmst: 1850-1900 where supported by the observational product
baseline_periods.sea_ice: product-native absolute units; no post-freeze anomaly recentering

missing_data_policy: A year is usable only when the preregistered observational operator can be evaluated without model-informed imputation. The evaluation remains not_available until 10 complete usable years exist.
dataset_integrity: Every observational input must carry acquisition URL/product identifier, version, download date, raw SHA-256, transformation script SHA-256, and processed SHA-256.

decision_rule.minimum_requirement: For each primary variable, CLEM RMSE must not exceed the best preregistered simple baseline RMSE; report all metrics and confidence intervals regardless of outcome.

spatial_extent_policy: R16 conservative 15-percent subgrid extent is diagnostic and excluded from the predictive release gate because longitude remains unresolved and extent is not a separate prognostic spatial state.
